blocks.text: ADC is a certified LumApps Technology and Implementation partner. Our founder was the first LumApps deployment consultant onboarded in the US, and we've served LumApps customers ever since. We're a boutique consulting and engineering firm specializing in deep integrations, AI (MCPs, Skills, Connectors), implementation, search, custom widget development, and enterprise UI/UX design. Our mission is simple: making LumApps a simpler, happier experience , for the teams who run it and the employees who use it every day.

Misha founded ADC in 2020 and became a LumApps partner. As a former Lumie, and one of the first deployment specialists in North America, he brings creative thought partnership and cross-industry expertise to his customers to help solve for their unique enterprise challenges relating to Enterprise Search, Architecture & Taxonomy and Employee Productivity, through strategic and solutions-oriented consulting as well as custom integrations.

Misha's cross-industry experience includes Fintech, Healthcare, Gaming, Application Performance Management, Real Estate, among many others. This, combined with his deep product knowledge and customer experience positions him well to provide well rounded advice and be a trusted partner and advisor to his customers.

Experienced in all the fields of the Software Craftmanship, from the QA to the development, from the Product Ownership to the Engineering Management. Also an ex-Lumie, Ivo is very hands-on and solutions oriented, bringing the art of technical reality to life. Ivo has a strong passion for everything related to Search and AI, and In his words "I am persuaded that everything we imagine can be brought to reality - it's just a matter of determining your Most Valuable Product."
Ariella focuses on creating high-impact ADC content and delivering it across multiple channels to elevate brand visibility, deepen customer engagement, and support revenue objectives.

blocks.text: Meet Page Reader, the first text-to-speech widget for LumApps . Give employees an easier way to consume content: Page Reader reads any LumApps page aloud, on desktop or mobile. It runs entirely in the user's browser, with no AI services and no third-party data sharing, so your content stays private and secure.
Deliver audio experiences native to LumApps' Design System , replacing third-party plugins or external tools that require added setup and access controls.
Offer multiple voices and languages so every employee can listen in the tone and language that suits them best.
Improve accessibility for employees with visual impairments, reading difficulties, or limited screen time, giving everyone an equal way to stay informed .
Increase engagement with LumApps content by letting employees listen anytime — at their desk, commuting, or on the move.
See the Page Reader Extension in action!
Text-to-speech. Powered by a natural-sounding speech engine, the widget reads any LumApps page or selected text aloud in real time.
Phonetics Pronunciations. Never wince at a mispronounced CEO name or product term again. Define custom phonetics once and Page Reader gets them right every time.
Custom voice selection . Choose from a library of natural voices , then fine-tune tone and pacing to match your brand and audience.
Speed control. Adjustable playback speed lets every employee, from fast skimmers to careful listeners, take in content the way they understand it best.
Mobile support. Listen on any device using the Browser native TTS— the widget adapts to mobile and tablet, letting employees catch up on content anywhere, anytime.
Analytics Tracking. A baked in widget class that allows connecting this widget to your GA4 instance, to pull click event analytics natively via Google or other enterprise solutions
Added value for your Internal Communications, HRBPs, and team leads
Turn onboarding guides and training materials into audio, so new hires can learn anytime, at their own pace.
Keep employees without daily desk access informed by letting them listen to key updates from a phone, between shifts.
Reach employees worldwide with natural-sounding voices across languages, making content easy to everywhere.
